name: Funda Nur Uşaklı
bio: Funda Nur Uşaklı was born in 1992 in Denizli, Turkey. From a young age, her greatest passions were reading and writing. In 2014, she graduated from Pamukkale University with a degree in Industrial Engineering. Although she trained as an industrial engineer, she chose not to pursue the profession, following her true passion instead. In 2020, she completed her undergraduate studies in Theatre History and Theory at Ankara University. She founded a theatre school called 6 Sahne in Denizli, where she wrote and performed in her own plays. She continues to teach acting, writing, and drama classes at 6 Sahne. Writing for children fulfills a childhood dream.
